meta.title: Add simple interpreter inlining
meta.body_summary: Add simple function inlining to the Mochi interpreter: track inline candidates, count calls, and inline hot pure single-expression functions to reduce call overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit interpreter inlining with no review or performance evidence; merged by author within ~1.8 hours.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 144 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR and is consistent with the successful, low-friction merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback available; PR was merged without formal review or comments.
review_details.performance_claim: Inlining hot, pure single-expression functions reduces call overhead in the interpreter.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Runtime inlining in an interpreted language requires understanding of execution semantics; the small scope and lack of review suggest low merge friction but no evidence of correctness validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after timing data; only a narrative claim of performance improvement via inlining.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR was self-merged without additional fixes.

core_change_summary.description: In interpreter/interpreter.go, added inlineCandidates and callCounts maps, logic to identify small pure functions, and inlining of their bodies at call sites to reduce call overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit (0c31869e) introduced inline candidate tracking, call counting, and inlining of hot pure single-expression functions.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by tamnd with Codex-authored commit; no reviews requested or received.
